The workbook generation failed to populate specific cell ranges, resulting in 'None' values where numeric matrix data was expected.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of expected floats (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). Command 'pytest /tests/test_outputs.py' reported 2 failed and 4 passed tests.
